source.note: INT merges the current branch tip. Its non-QA content is byte-identical to the frozen PHASE03A_CODE_SHA 21b2bd7; the extra commits are qa-reports receipts only, so integration receives the complete evidence trail.

rollbackPointer.recovery: git -C <integration worktree> reset --hard 5a64c917 restores the exact pre-INT state. The source branch is untouched by the INT and is itself a complete backup of the merged content.

ancestry.divergence: NONE - the target is a strict ancestor, so the integration branch is simply stale relative to accepted work

mergeForecast.mechanic: git merge --no-ff <exact source SHA> executed IN the integration worktree, producing an explicit two-parent integration commit. --no-ff is chosen over a fast-forward specifically so the integration event is auditable with recorded parents. No squash, rebase, reset, cherry-pick, force or global ours/theirs.

authorCorrectionRecorded.initialMisreading: A path-filtered diff showed six files under supabase/migrations/ as 'D' (deleted), which I first reported as the INT deleting six applied migrations including five MOD1/MOD1R moderation ones.
authorCorrectionRecorded.whatIsActuallyTrue: They are R100 - one hundred percent RENAMES into supabase/nonmanaged/proposed/. The 'D' appeared only because my path filter hid the destination. All six were verified byte-identical between the integration branch's supabase/migrations/ copy and the source's supabase/nonmanaged/proposed/ copy. ZERO content is lost.
authorCorrectionRecorded.whyTheRenameIsCorrect: The accepted Phase 02 baseline c2e36800 contains exactly 71 applied migrations and none of these six. They are absent from migration-crosswalk.v1.json entirely. They were never applied to production, so Phase 02B commit 2ae55f9 reclassified them from applied to proposed. The integration branch predates that canonicalisation.

expectedDiff.productSourceNote: These are pre-existing accepted Phase 02B and earlier Phase 03A caller changes that the stale integration branch has not yet received. They are NOT introduced by this run - this run changed zero product source.
expectedDiff.releaseControlTouched: NONE - release/, docs/RELEASE_IDENTITY.md, vercel.json, app.json and eas.json are all unchanged by the INT

recoveryIfInterrupted: Do NOT assume success or failure and do NOT reset or abort blindly. Inspect the integration worktree's actual HEAD: if it equals 5a64c917 the INT never applied; if it is a new merge commit with parents 5a64c917 and the source SHA, the INT applied and only verification remains.
